title: Get Codey Playbook
description: Read-only. CALL THIS FIRST in a new conversation about Enterprise Sales Management (ESM) setup. Returns the Project Codey playbook (routing, golden rules), a skill (topic=skill:fresh-install|settings-health-check|permissions|upgrade-check|concepts-guide|pricing|customization|bulk-members), a runbook (runbook:US-01..US-11), a concept (concept:<key>, add quoteId for real examples from the org), the recommended settings (settings) or the release change list (releases); topic=index lists all. Follow the skill it routes to. Golden rules: look first; every change is mode=preview, show the Approval card, wait for an explicit yes, then mode=commit with the previewToken and the SAME inputs; secrets never in chat; keep replies short.

title: Check ESM Setup
description: Read-only ESM settings health check (about 1 minute). scope: all (default), prereq (fresh-install prerequisites), quoting, assets (add assets to quote), performance, console, permissions, adminjobs. Returns each item as OK / Warning / Needs Fix with the reason, current vs recommended value (secrets masked), a help link and a Fix it message, plus a Health check report card. Nothing changes. Offer fixes one by one; each fix is a preview the person approves (apply_esm_change, manage_esm_permissions or run_esm_admin_jobs).

title: Manage ESM Permissions
description: Give ESM users the recommended permission sets for their user type (Sales rep, Sales manager, Admin, Pricing admin, Product designer, Service agent, Coworker user). Inputs: userType, users (usernames, e-mails, names or Ids) or profile / role. ALWAYS mode=preview first: the Approval card lists per user what is missing. Only after the person explicitly approves, call mode=commit with the previewToken and the same inputs. Only adds, never removes. Production orgs also need confirmProduction=true after the person confirms.

title: Apply ESM Change
description: Approved ESM configuration change with Before/After preview and undo. changeType: cpqSetting or enrichQuoteOption (target=setting name, value), generalSetting, pricingPlanStep (fieldsJson name, sequence, implementation, method, parameters, active; recordId to update), contextRule (fieldsJson name, ruleset, product, expression, failureMessage; created inactive), contextRuleset, attributeBinding (Quote Member Binding: attribute, objectClass, fieldApiName), linearRelationship (product, relatedProduct, relationshipType), record (allow-listed ESM objects), undo (target=change log CL-...). ALWAYS mode=preview, show the Approval card, wait for an explicit yes, then mode=commit with previewToken and the same inputs. Never pass secrets (keys) – they go through the secure Codey Setup page.

title: Run ESM Admin Jobs
description: ESM admin (maintenance) jobs in the documented order with progress. jobs: default (recommended), catalog, pricing, promotions, repair, or job keys. mode=preview lists the jobs (automatic and manual steps); after the person approves, mode=commit with previewToken and same inputs starts them in the background and returns a jobId and a Progress tracker card. mode=status (jobId) shows progress and plain-language errors. A failed run resumes from the failed step: mode=preview with jobId, approval, then mode=commit with jobId. Only one run at a time.

title: Preview ESM Price
description: Price a sample quote WITHOUT saving anything (rolled back): products (names/codes/Ids), optional quantity, account, priceList. Returns total, price per line, every pricing step (list price, promotions, discounts, manual adjustments) and the promotions and discounts applied. explainPlan=true lists the pricing plan steps in order. quoteId (without products) explains an existing quote's prices read-only. proposedStepJson simulates a new pricing plan step: before vs after. mode=commit (after approval, same inputs + previewToken) keeps the sample as a test quote (fresh install).

title: Check Quote Members Bulk
description: Load many quote members from a spreadsheet and check addresses and serviceability in the background (10,000+ members, batches, retries, resume). Inputs: quoteId (Id or name), membersCsv (header row: name/site, street/address, city, state, postal code/zip, country – read the attached spreadsheet and pass its rows) or contentDocumentId (069...), checks (address, serviceability; none to only load). ALWAYS mode=preview first (columns, rows to load, duplicates, rows with errors); after the person approves, mode=commit with previewToken and same inputs. Then track_codey_job; when done share the results file.

title: Check ESM Upgrade Impact
description: Read-only upgrade check: which customized ESM screens and procedures (FlexCards, OmniScripts, Integration Procedures) a release affects (targetRelease, default newest in the release change list), what changed, a risk level (High / Medium / Low) and a suggested action, as an Upgrade impact report card. includeStandard=true also lists components that are not customized. Reports only; a combined (merged) version is a suggestion for review and is never deployed without approval.

title: Track Codey Job
description: Read-only progress of a Project Codey background job (admin jobs, bulk member checks): jobId (or CJ-... name), or quoteId / tool for the latest job. Returns status, percent done, each step, plain-language errors, the results file link and whether it can resume, as a Progress tracker card. Check about once a minute while running; do not start a second job.
